items.title: Eat a Fish Bit
items.detail: Craft at a Cooking Station by processing caught fish.

items.title: Catch a Fish in the Forest Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Deathclaw Island and use a fishing rod.

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity while in a Team
items.detail: Join any team from Social menu; you can be alone on it.

items.title: Cripple a Protectron or a Robobrain's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center and use V.A.T.S.

items.title: Eat a Cobbler, which is not a Pie.
items.detail: Cook Cranberry Cobbler or Starlight Berry Cobbler at Cooking Station.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Pistol
items.detail: Craft 10mm Pistol at Weapons Workbench; try Wavy Willard's Water Park.

items.title: Sell Bloatfly Meat to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Find Bloatflies at New River Gorge Resort or Super Duper Mart.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other dailies on three separate days during the week.

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Find at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join or create a Daily Ops public team and complete one.

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Build a Tinkerer's Bench in C.A.M.P. or use one at Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Spooky Scorched appear during seasonal event; try Morgantown Airport.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Whitespring Golf Club has dense Feral Ghouls that are easy targets.

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume (hat or mask works); try Poseidon Energy Plant.

items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get from Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Repeatable Under Rank 100: Gain XP
items.detail: Earn XP by playing; repeats until Scoreboard rank 100.

items.title: Repeatable at Rank 100 or above: Complete a Public Event
items.detail: Complete any public event; popular ones include Eviction Notice.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Spooky Scorched enemies appear across Appalachia with Halloween costumes and offer special rewards including mystery candy and legendary items.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this weekend event.

events.name: Minerva (List 7)
events.description: Minerva sells a rotating list of plans and items for Gold.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double SCORE and caps during this weekend bonus event.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Special anniversary celebration event with unique rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Earn double XP to level up faster during this weekend.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed Scorched enemies appear with festive rewards and special loot.
